description:
The image displays a technical section drawing titled "Diagram 8 Damp proof courses (see paragraph 5.5(b))". It shows two arrangements side by side, each made up of a vertical wall cross‑section on the left and a floor cross‑section on the right.

In the left arrangement the wall is a single solid dark grey block running from the damp proof course down to the bottom of the drawing. At the top of the wall a horizontal line of small black dashes is identified by an arrow from the words "Damp proof course". To the left of the wall a vertical dimension line with an arrow at each end measures the distance from a ground level line up to the damp proof course and is labelled "At least 150mm if wall is an external wall". The ground level line carries a ground level symbol drawn as an inverted triangle with a horizontal line across the top.

To the right of the wall is a lighter grey block representing the floor, its top at the level of the damp proof course. At the junction between the wall and the floor a dashed line runs vertically downwards from the damp proof course and then turns to run horizontally, forming the floor damp‑proof membrane. Above this junction a note reading "The wall damp‑proof course should be continuous with the floor damp‑proof membrane" points to the dashed line. Below the floor block is a horizontal band of small circular shapes resting on a bed of irregular stones and rubble.

The right arrangement is similar, but the wall is split into two separate vertical dark grey blocks with a narrow gap between them, and the floor block with its band of circular shapes over rubble is shown to the right of the wall as before. The same dimension line, label and ground level symbol appear to the left of the wall, and the same note about continuity points to the dashed membrane at the junction between the wall and the floor.

In both sections, a solid grey block represents the wall. A horizontal line with black dashes indicates the "Damp proof course". A vertical dimension line points to this course, labelled "At least 150mm if wall is an external wall", measuring the distance upwards from the "Ground level" symbol, which is a triangle with a horizontal line.

Below the damp proof course, the foundation is shown with a layer of circular shapes sitting on a bed of irregular stones and rubble. A horizontal dashed line, representing a membrane, extends inwards from the base of the wall DPC. Text pointing to this junction in both sections reads: "The wall damp-proof course should be continuous with the floor damp-proof membrane".

The left section shows a single, unbroken vertical wall. The right section shows a similar arrangement, but the wall is divided into two parts separated by a vertical line, and there is a vertical gap between the wall and the foundation block on the right.
